tasks.short: Monitor cash, reserves and financial obligations, investigate exceptions and escalate required action.

steps.what: Check balances, restricted cash and recent movements in the {BANK}.
Check upcoming receipts, payments and ledger balances in the {ERP}.
Combine figures and reconcile differences in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Compare figures with documented covenants, restrictions and reporting obligations in the {DOCS}.
Discuss exceptions with the finance team and determine their significance.
Prepare the monitoring report in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Validated figures, record identifiers and the treasurer's exception assessment.
loop.output: Draft monitoring report with linked figures and attributed explanations.
loop.check: Code checks figures and record links; the treasurer checks explanations and omitted exceptions.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass per report; otherwise use the numeric template.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables are deterministic, but explanations must combine varied written exception assessments.

steps.what: Send the approved report and escalate proposed corrective action through the {EMAIL}.

tasks.design: Scheduled imports from the {BANK} and {ERP} feed reconciliations and approved obligation checks on the {DATA_PLATFORM}, with freshness and exception views in the {BI}. A bounded loop drafts commentary in the {DOCS}; the treasurer approves publication and routes corrective-action requests through the {WORKFLOW}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Account mappings, obligation definitions and reconciliation ownership were fragmented. Legal interpretation could not safely be reduced to balance checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing exports, approval workflows and deterministic checks already cover much of the preparation. AI coding can shorten connector and report development; a small model loop can draft grounded commentary.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying applicable obligations, interpreting restrictions and resolving stale or disputed figures remain expensive. A dashboard cannot establish legal compliance by itself.
tasks.human_edge: The treasurer distinguishes a data error from a material exposure and decides when specialist advice or escalation is needed.

ambition.what: Daily review of projected liquidity headroom against approved obligations.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from collecting balances to investigating exceptions and testing corrective options. The treasurer gains earlier visibility; authority to waive obligations or release funds does not change.

reach.task: Design liquidity stress triggers and escalation thresholds.
reach.learn: Stress assumptions, covenant interpretation and the difference between warning indicators and breaches.

reach.task: Resolve differences between bank balances and ledger records.
reach.learn: Reconciliation controls, evidence retention and period cutoffs.

evidence.claim: Bank and ledger feeds, reconciliations and threshold alerts can use deterministic technology.
Nomentia documents cash forecasting from bank and ERP data with forecast-to-actual comparison; this does not establish legal compliance.
Material exception interpretation and corrective decisions still require accountable human judgement.

assumptions: This is a corporate treasury function, not a regulated financial institution.
Reserve monitoring covers applicable legal reserves, restricted cash and internal liquidity buffers.
The obligation register is approved by finance and relevant legal specialists before checks are automated.
Shares and remaining time are planning estimates; structured inputs do not make legal judgement rule-covered.
Build ranges are working-day estimates for one initial scope and may overlap.
GDPR and the EU AI Act require an applicability assessment; access time includes national employee consultation where applicable.
unknowns: Which legal entities, reserve requirements and covenants are in scope?
Are bank feeds and ledger exports available with reliable identifiers and timestamps?
Who approves the obligation register and accepts unresolved reconciliation differences?
Do staff-level records enter the monitoring data, and do national consultation rules apply?
research_questions: Which existing {ERP} and {BANK} controls can be configured before building connectors?
How well do proposed checks reproduce previously investigated exceptions?
Can report commentary remain useful when source data is incomplete or delayed?
new_work: Review reconciliation and compliance exceptions.
Maintain account mappings, obligation definitions and thresholds.
Check report commentary and approve publication.
Monitor feed failures, data freshness and access logs.
Reassess privacy and employee consultation requirements when scope changes.

tasks.short: Assess funding needs and surplus cash, compare options and recommend financing or investment actions.

steps.what: Review forecast cash requirements and available facilities in the {ERP} and {BANK}.
Model cash shortfalls, surplus duration and stress scenarios in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Read financing proposals and permitted investment terms in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Financing proposals and investment terms, including fees, maturity, restrictions and liquidity clauses.
loop.output: Draft option terms with page references and explicit missing fields.
loop.check: Validate units, dates and required fields; the treasurer verifies material terms against source passages.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass per document; unresolved terms remain missing for manual review.
loop.why_not_simpler: Proposal layouts and contractual wording vary; fixed calculations work after terms are confirmed.

steps.what: Compare costs, returns, liquidity and policy limits in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Assess uncertainty, counterparty exposure and strategic flexibility before selecting a recommendation.
Prepare the decision memorandum in the {DOCS}.
Discuss the recommendation and approve the funding or investment decision.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} combines approved cash forecasts from the {ERP} and {BANK} with deterministic liquidity scenarios and policy checks in the {BI}. A bounded loop extracts proposal terms into a reviewed register, and templates in the {DOCS} assemble the treasurer's recommendation for approval through the {WORKFLOW}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Forecast versions, proposal terms and risk limits were disconnected. Bespoke scenario tools took effort to build, while selecting an option remained a judgement call.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured feeds and reusable calculation libraries can support inexpensive scenario tools. AI coding speeds implementation, and bounded extraction reduces document preparation without predicting the right financial decision.
tasks.still_hard: Forecast uncertainty, changing terms, counterparty risk and strategic flexibility remain difficult to quantify. Contractual interpretation and execution authority require separate review.
tasks.human_edge: The treasurer balances liquidity, cost, risk and the organisation's need to change course.

ambition.what: Weekly review of funding readiness under an approved downside cash scenario.

tasks.altitude: The treasurer spends more time challenging assumptions and discussing options with business leaders. They can initiate earlier funding reviews, but borrowing, investment and transaction approval limits remain governed by the delegation register.

reach.task: Compare permitted investment instruments under liquidity and counterparty constraints.
reach.learn: Maturity, liquidity, credit exposure and fee-adjusted returns.

reach.task: Translate operating plans into cash timing assumptions.
reach.learn: Working-capital drivers, scenario dependencies and forecast uncertainty.

evidence.claim: Nomentia documents statistical cash forecasting and comparison with actual cash flows.
Liquidity scenarios, fee calculations and approved policy-limit checks can run deterministically.
Document extraction can assist preparation but does not validate an investment or financing recommendation.

assumptions: Surplus investment means corporate cash management, not managing an investment fund.
The scope ends at an approved decision; transaction execution is a separate controlled workflow.
Scenario formulas and policy limits are approved before use.
The judgement-heavy prior is retained: arithmetic and document preparation improve more than option selection.
Shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates requiring local validation.
Access and consultation ranges cover GDPR review and national employee consultation where applicable; EU AI Act applicability is assessed.
unknowns: Which instruments, counterparties and financing facilities are permitted?
Who can approve borrowing, investments and policy exceptions?
How accurate and timely are cash forecasts?
Are proposal documents standardised, and can material terms be stored in a structured register?
Does the intended data scope trigger national employee consultation requirements?
research_questions: Can existing {ERP} forecasting and approval configuration cover the initial scope?
Which downside assumptions changed previous funding decisions?
How reliably can extraction identify liquidity restrictions and additional fees?
new_work: Review extracted terms and resolve missing clauses.
Maintain calculation formulas, scenario assumptions and counterparty limits.
Compare forecast cash flows with actual outcomes.
Review generated memoranda and preserve decision evidence.
Maintain connectors, permissions and model-loop checks.

tasks.short: Maintain trusted relationships with banks, insurers and external accountants to support financial activities.

steps.what: Review correspondence and agreements in the {EMAIL} and {DOCS} before counterpart meetings.

loop.input: Selected correspondence, agreements, relationship notes and open actions for one counterparty.
loop.output: Draft meeting brief with source links, open questions and unresolved commitments.
loop.check: Require source links for factual claims; the treasurer checks commitments, tone and sensitive material.
loop.stop: One brief and one correction pass per meeting; missing evidence is flagged, then preparation returns to manual.
loop.why_not_simpler: Important context is scattered across varied correspondence and narrative notes.

steps.what: Arrange the meeting through the {EMAIL} and {CALENDAR}.
Discuss needs, concerns and service performance with the external counterparty.
Agree the internal response to requests and proposed commitments.
Record the meeting outcome and action owners in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: The treasurer's written discussion notes and separately approved commitments.
loop.output: Draft relationship note and proposed action rows with owners and dates.
loop.check: The treasurer confirms attribution, owners and dates; code rejects commitments absent from the approved list.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; ambiguous owners or commitments require manual entry.
loop.why_not_simpler: Written meeting notes vary, while the resulting action records need consistent fields.

steps.what: Send agreed follow-up actions to the counterparty through the {EMAIL}.

tasks.design: A counterparty register in the {WORKFLOW} links agreements in the {DOCS}, selected correspondence in the {EMAIL} and meetings in the {CALENDAR}. Bounded loops prepare briefs and structure written notes, while configured scheduling and reminders handle coordination; the treasurer conducts conversations and approves outward commitments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relationship context sat in personal mailboxes and memory. Scheduling tools existed, but scattered notes made preparation and follow-through inconsistent.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured scheduling, shared action records and permissioned document retrieval can handle coordination. Bounded drafting can organise selected correspondence without taking over the relationship.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, negotiating sensitive issues and recognising unspoken concerns remain human work. Capturing enough context without indiscriminate mailbox access also takes care.
tasks.human_edge: The treasurer earns trust, reads the room and knows when to ask for flexibility or challenge a counterparty.
tasks.altitude: The treasurer arrives better prepared and spends less time chasing actions. Relationship ownership and financial decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Prepare counterparty concentration reviews before bank relationship discussions.
reach.learn: Exposure aggregation, credit signals and escalation thresholds.

reach.task: Coordinate evidence requests with external accountants.
reach.learn: Evidence sufficiency, engagement scope and professional independence.

evidence.claim: Scheduling, action registers and reminders can be configured without an autonomous agent.
Bounded drafting can assist meeting preparation and written records; relationship judgement remains human.
GDPR applies when contact details and identifiable correspondence are processed.

assumptions: Conversation remains the largest time component, consistent with the relationship-heavy prior.
The coordination share is a working estimate; the weak mail prior is not treated as measured evidence.
Automatic invitations use an approved contact list and availability rules, without confidential attachments.
Conversation itself does not authorise binding financial commitments; those follow the delegation register.
Loops use selected written notes; recording or transcribing meetings is outside this scope.
Build ranges include permission review and national employee consultation where applicable; EU AI Act applicability is assessed.
unknowns: How much time currently goes into preparation, scheduling and follow-up?
Which correspondence and notes may be shared with the finance team?
Who approves different types of counterparty commitment?
Are approved contact lists and shared calendars available?
Does mailbox access require employee consultation under national rules?
research_questions: Can configuration of the {CALENDAR} and {WORKFLOW} deliver most coordination benefits?
Do generated briefs preserve disputed commitments and unresolved concerns?
Would shared action records alone solve the main follow-through problem?
new_work: Review meeting briefs for missing context and sensitive content.
Confirm relationship notes and proposed action owners.
Approve external follow-up messages.
Maintain counterparty contacts, access boundaries and retention settings.
Review overdue actions without turning reminders into unnecessary counterpart messages.

tasks.short: Assign and control authority over receipts, payments, bank access and custody of financial assets.

steps.what: Check current roles, employment status and reporting lines in the {HCM}.
Review existing mandates and authority limits in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Signed mandates and custody agreements plus the existing delegation register.
loop.output: Draft authority fields with source references, expiry dates and conflicting entries.
loop.check: Validate required fields and cross-check against the register; the treasurer verifies identities and limits.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass per document; unresolved identity or scope conflicts block updates.
loop.why_not_simpler: Legacy signed documents vary in format and wording; structured mandates should bypass the loop.

steps.what: Check proposed authority for segregation conflicts in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Discuss responsibilities and choose the proposed scope and limits of delegation.
Approve and sign the mandate through the {ESIGN}.
Submit and approve bank authority changes in the {BANK}.
Update receipt, payment and custody permissions in the {ERP}.
Verify acknowledgements and update the delegation register in the {DOCS}.

tasks.design: A delegation register in the {WORKFLOW} links role status from the {HCM}, approved mandates in the {DOCS} and deterministic segregation checks on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Signed approvals through the {ESIGN} route separate permission changes in the {BANK} and {ERP}, with acknowledgements reconciled before the register marks a change complete.
tasks.previous_blocker: Signed mandates, employee changes and actual permissions were held separately. Authority decisions were confused with the administrative work needed to implement them.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing role templates, approval controls and structured registers can coordinate changes. AI coding can speed reconciliation and evidence assembly; a bounded loop can extract legacy mandate fields.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing trusted delegates, setting appropriate limits and resolving conflicting duties remain human decisions. Banks may require particular signatures or manual processes, and acknowledgements may arrive late.
tasks.human_edge: The treasurer judges competence, trust, independence and the practical consequences of granting financial authority.

ambition.what: Event-triggered review of financial authority after a role change or departure.

tasks.altitude: The treasurer spends less time locating mandates and more time reviewing sensitive delegations and conflicts. They can initiate earlier access reviews; no additional payment or bank-signatory rights are gained.

reach.task: Identify combinations of financial permissions that could enable concealment or misuse.
reach.learn: Fraud scenarios, collusion limits and compensating controls.

reach.task: Maintain evidence for financial authority reviews and control exceptions.
reach.learn: Control ownership, approval evidence and exception expiry.

evidence.claim: Role templates, approval workflows and deterministic segregation checks can assist financial delegation administration.
Granting financial authority requires judgement distinct from preparing and applying approved permissions.
GDPR Article 22 limits solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on individuals.
Employee-data and monitoring changes may require consultation under national rules.

assumptions: Delegation is corporate financial administration; specialised securities custody is included only where relevant.
The {BANK} and {ERP} support suitable role templates and separate approval controls; unsupported changes remain manual.
Conflict checks flag approved rule violations and do not decide whether a person is trustworthy.
No model ranks employees or automatically grants, removes or expands their authority.
Approval roles represent the required authorisation path; some companies also require board approval or multiple signatories.
Shares, remaining time and build ranges are estimates; no universal bank API or access entitlement is assumed.
Access ranges include GDPR and EU AI Act applicability review and national works-council or employee consultation where applicable.
unknowns: Which bank, receipt, payment and custody permissions are in scope?
Who legally approves mandates, and which changes require multiple signatures?
Do actual permissions match the current delegation register?
Which {BANK} and {ERP} changes support configuration, imports or approval workflows?
Are identity records, departure events and role changes timely and reliable?
Which national employee consultation requirements apply?
research_questions: Can existing {BANK} and {ERP} approval configuration implement the required separation of duties?
Which historical permission conflicts would the proposed checks have detected?
Can acknowledgements prove actual permissions rather than merely submitted requests?
Which mandate formats require extraction, and which can use structured fields directly?
new_work: Review extracted mandate fields and identity conflicts.
Maintain segregation rules, role templates and approval routes.
Approve each sensitive permission change in its destination system.
Investigate missing acknowledgements and differences from approved mandates.
Test departure and role-change triggers and maintain access evidence.
Review control exceptions and their expiry dates.

role.altitude: The role shifts toward liquidity choices, exception investigation, counterparty relationships and financial authority decisions. Better preparation supports earlier intervention; formal borrowing, investment and payment powers still come from approved mandates.
reach: Financial Risk Specialists: develop liquidity stress scenarios and counterparty exposure reviews.
Budget Analysts: connect operating plans to cash timing and forecast uncertainty.
Accountants and Auditors: strengthen reconciliations and financial control evidence.
Fraud Examiners, Investigators and Analysts: test sensitive permission combinations.
skills_to_grow: Cash scenario design and forecast evaluation.
Financial data lineage and reconciliation controls.
Translating approved obligations into testable checks.
Reviewing extracted contract terms and grounded commentary.
Segregation of duties and permission-change verification.
role.ambitious_version: Run an early-warning treasury service that connects cash scenarios, funding readiness and authority changes. Bring concrete options to decision-makers sooner while preserving human judgement and existing approval limits.
